objective: Owner-authorized DEV improvement to BUKLOD Health Center: make educational IMCI caregiver prompts fully guided in Tagalog, age-aware, and conservative for emergency escalation without enabling unverified clinical services.
productionBaselineEvidence: Starting source main 088df3cc1265a097744f78f4f24aaa3ae5ad3586 (Nov 22, 2026). Live production app, new source runtime and exact Android rendering NOT verified by this workstream; no release authorized.
chosenApproach: In-app, privacy-first educational IMCI question flow with age-specific prompts, clear progress, local-only answers and caregiver handoff notes. Inline clinical red flags immediately block nonurgent AI/ads and show ER/911 guidance. Existing separately gated Health Center PWA and authentication remain untouched.
selectionRationale: The existing English-only six-step IMCI description was static and failed to guide caregivers, while AI consultation and professional enrollment remain backend-gated. A small in-app local-first flow is useful without inventing clinician services or persisting sensitive data.
alternativeApproaches: Auto-classify IMCI disease or prescribe treatments: rejected because clinician assessment and currently adopted Philippine chart validation are required.
Store child symptoms in Supabase: rejected because no clinical purpose, consent, permissions or private health record backend is certified.
Activate AI/doctor portal flags prematurely: rejected until separate authenticated backend and health-professional verification.
preserveBehaviors: Do not change BUKLOD login, auth tokens, personal medical records or full Health Center external URL paths.
Keep AI consultation and professional enrollment disabled unless environment-specific backend proof explicitly activates them.
Preserve emergency 911 link and suppress advice/ads when the adult or IMCI screen is urgent.
Do not alter existing Home navigation, advertisements outside this nonurgent Health Center placement, or non-health app features.
No native dependencies, server-side writes, SQL migrations, OTA releases, or production changes.
acceptanceChecks: Tagalog IMCI age bands: under two months, two months to under five years, five years plus safety-only.
Yes or unsure on a danger sign => immediate emergency stop and local 911 referral; priority signs => clinician review; no clinical diagnosis or medicine dosing.
Questions are handled one by one with accessible answer buttons, back, retry, progress and handoff summary.
No health answers sent to network, analytics, external URL queries, or persistent storage.
Regression proof: changed scoped health flow and existing Health Center consultation/ad tests; protected feature gate passes.
Source compile, real device rendering, and Philippine clinician review are mandatory before release approval; remain unverified until evidenced.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add owner-requested Tagalog IMCI caregiver UI and reconcile existing health screening gates without changing backend privileges, data storage, release or native runtime behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Health Center remains accessible from its original route, with the same three fixed links, default-disabled consultation/professional flags, adult emergency screening and nonurgent ad policy.

releaseStatus: Draft PR, pending targeted CI, TypeScript/Android QA, latest local Philippine IMCI clinician review and explicit staging consolidation. Production unchanged.
